# Slideline

> Slideline (https://slideline.co) turns a project plan into a clean, slide-ready Gantt chart. A whole plan, design included, travels inside one link: nothing is uploaded, and no account or API key is needed. The same link works for people and for AI: you can read it, edit it, or write a new one.

When someone asks you to make a plan in Slideline, or for a Slideline link, chart or Gantt chart, give back a link that opens the finished chart, not a task list for them to paste into Import. When someone gives you a Slideline link and asks for changes, read the plan from the link, change it, and give back a new link.

## The link

    https://slideline.co/#plan=<the plan as JSON>&style=<design settings>

- The plan part is JSON describing the items: names, dates, owners, progress, status and dependencies.
- The style part is the design: palette, font, layout and so on. Only settings that differ from the defaults are listed. It is optional. Leave it out when you create a plan from scratch.
- Slideline writes the JSON "quote-light" so the link stays short and readable: ' instead of ", and _ instead of a space. Inside a name, %5F is a real underscore, %5C%27 is an apostrophe, and other %XX codes are ordinary percent-encoding (%26 is &, %23 is #, %E2%80%94 is an em dash).
- When you write a link, you can use the same quote-light style, or plain JSON percent-encoded with encodeURIComponent. Both open.

## Editing a link someone gives you

1. Read the plan part as JSON, as described above.
2. Make the change they ask for: move dates, add or remove items, rename, change owners, progress or status.
3. Keep every field and id you didn't mean to change, including colour, baseline, note, key, msAlign and the ids used by "after".
4. Copy the &style=… part back exactly as it was, unless they asked for a design change.
5. Give back the full new link, and say in one line what you changed.

## The plan format

    {
      "title": "Website relaunch",
      "status": "green",
      "items": [ ...items, top to bottom... ]
    }

"status" (optional) is the overall project status: "green", "amber" or "red".

Each item can have:

    name        Required. Keep it short, under about 40 characters.
    start, end  First and last day, "YYYY-MM-DD"; end is inclusive (a one-day task has start equal to end).
    days        Instead of end: the length in calendar days.
    milestone   true for a one-day event such as a launch, sign-off or deadline. Give it "date": "YYYY-MM-DD".
    items       The items inside this one.
    owner       A person or team.
    progress    0 to 100, percent done. null means progress isn't tracked for this item.
    status      "green" (on track), "amber" (at risk) or "red" (off track), unless the style part defines other statuses.
    id          A short id, used by "after". Any number or text that is unique in the plan.
    after       The items this one waits for, by id or by exact name, e.g. [3] or ["Wireframes"].
    key         true marks a key milestone.
    blocked     true, or a short reason as text, flags the item as blocked.
    note        One short line of commentary, up to 120 characters, shown in the legend.

Slideline also writes these look-and-history fields. Keep them as they are when editing: color, baseline, changeNote, noteOff, msAlign, keepTask, newLine, blockedNote.

Structure: use at most three levels. A top-level item with items inside is an area (a phase or workstream). An area's dates come from what is inside it, so an area has no dates. Inside an area go tasks and milestones, and a task can hold subtasks. Use real calendar dates. If the person gives no start date, start on the coming Monday.

## The style part

A comma-separated list of name:value pairs, for example:

    &style=palette:vivid,font:Lora,assignees:true,progress:true,scale:months

You rarely need to write it yourself. Without one, Slideline uses its default design, and it shows owners, progress and dependency arrows when the plan uses them. When a person asks for a design change, these are the common settings:

    palette     bold, spectrum, vivid, corporate, earth, pastel or candy
    font        A Google Fonts family, with _ for spaces, e.g. Playfair_Display
    scale       days, weeks, sprints, months or quarters
    assignees   true or false: show owners
    progress    true or false: show progress
    deps        true or false: show dependency arrows
    todayLine   true or false: draw a date marker; todayDate:YYYY-MM-DD fixes its date
    execView    true or false: one bar per area, for executives
    criticalPath true or false: highlight the critical path

Other settings may appear. Keep them unless asked to change them.

## Limits

- Keep the whole link under about 6,000 characters, which is roughly 60 to 80 items with short names. Some chat apps, email clients and messengers cut longer links. For a bigger plan, drop the notes or give one link per phase.
- Names over about 40 characters get cramped on the chart, though the full name is kept.
- Dates must fall between 1990 and 2100.
- A link is a snapshot. Changes made after opening it stay in that browser. To send a newer version, the person uses Share link in Slideline.

## Worked example: creating a plan

The plan:

    {
      "title": "Website relaunch",
      "items": [
        {
          "name": "Discovery",
          "items": [
            {
              "name": "Kickoff",
              "milestone": true,
              "date": "2027-01-04"
            },
            {
              "name": "Stakeholder interviews",
              "start": "2027-01-04",
              "end": "2027-01-15",
              "owner": "Priya"
            },
            {
              "name": "Research synthesis",
              "start": "2027-01-18",
              "end": "2027-01-22",
              "owner": "Sam",
              "after": [
                "Stakeholder interviews"
              ]
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "Design",
          "items": [
            {
              "name": "Wireframes",
              "start": "2027-01-25",
              "end": "2027-02-05",
              "owner": "Lena",
              "after": [
                "Research synthesis"
              ]
            },
            {
              "name": "Visual design",
              "start": "2027-02-08",
              "end": "2027-02-19",
              "owner": "Marco",
              "after": [
                "Wireframes"
              ]
            },
            {
              "name": "Design sign-off",
              "milestone": true,
              "date": "2027-02-19",
              "key": true
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "name": "Build",
          "items": [
            {
              "name": "Front-end",
              "start": "2027-02-22",
              "end": "2027-03-19",
              "owner": "Ana",
              "after": [
                "Visual design"
              ]
            },
            {
              "name": "Content migration",
              "start": "2027-03-01",
              "end": "2027-03-19",
              "owner": "Sam"
            },
            {
              "name": "Go-live",
              "milestone": true,
              "date": "2027-03-26",
              "key": true,
              "after": [
                "Front-end",
                "Content migration"
              ]
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }

The link to give back:

https://slideline.co/#plan={'title':'Website_relaunch','items':[{'name':'Discovery','items':[{'name':'Kickoff','milestone':true,'date':'2027-01-04'},{'id':1,'name':'Stakeholder_interviews','start':'2027-01-04','end':'2027-01-15','owner':'Priya'},{'id':2,'name':'Research_synthesis','start':'2027-01-18','end':'2027-01-22','owner':'Sam','after':[1]}]},{'name':'Design','items':[{'id':3,'name':'Wireframes','start':'2027-01-25','end':'2027-02-05','owner':'Lena','after':[2]},{'id':4,'name':'Visual_design','start':'2027-02-08','end':'2027-02-19','owner':'Marco','after':[3]},{'name':'Design_sign-off','milestone':true,'date':'2027-02-19','key':true}]},{'name':'Build','items':[{'id':5,'name':'Front-end','start':'2027-02-22','end':'2027-03-19','owner':'Ana','after':[4]},{'id':6,'name':'Content_migration','start':'2027-03-01','end':'2027-03-19','owner':'Sam'},{'name':'Go-live','milestone':true,'date':'2027-03-26','key':true,'after':[5,6]}]}]}&style=deps:true,assignees:true,dateOrder:mdy

## Worked example: editing a plan

The person sends this link and says "Front-end will take a week longer; Jo is joining Ana on it, and it's 40% done":

https://slideline.co/#plan={'title':'Website_relaunch','items':[{'name':'Discovery','items':[{'name':'Kickoff','milestone':true,'date':'2027-01-04'},{'id':1,'name':'Stakeholder_interviews','start':'2027-01-04','end':'2027-01-15','owner':'Priya'},{'id':2,'name':'Research_synthesis','start':'2027-01-18','end':'2027-01-22','owner':'Sam','after':[1]}]},{'name':'Design','items':[{'id':3,'name':'Wireframes','start':'2027-01-25','end':'2027-02-05','owner':'Lena','after':[2]},{'id':4,'name':'Visual_design','start':'2027-02-08','end':'2027-02-19','owner':'Marco','after':[3]},{'name':'Design_sign-off','milestone':true,'date':'2027-02-19','key':true}]},{'name':'Build','items':[{'id':5,'name':'Front-end','start':'2027-02-22','end':'2027-03-19','owner':'Ana','after':[4]},{'id':6,'name':'Content_migration','start':'2027-03-01','end':'2027-03-19','owner':'Sam'},{'name':'Go-live','milestone':true,'date':'2027-03-26','key':true,'after':[5,6]}]}]}&style=deps:true,assignees:true,dateOrder:dmy,progress:true,palette:vivid,font:Lora

You give back this link. Front-end's end date, owner and progress changed, Go-live moved a week, and the style part was copied over unchanged:

https://slideline.co/#plan={'title':'Website_relaunch','items':[{'name':'Discovery','items':[{'name':'Kickoff','milestone':true,'date':'2027-01-04'},{'id':1,'name':'Stakeholder_interviews','start':'2027-01-04','end':'2027-01-15','owner':'Priya'},{'id':2,'name':'Research_synthesis','start':'2027-01-18','end':'2027-01-22','owner':'Sam','after':[1]}]},{'name':'Design','items':[{'id':3,'name':'Wireframes','start':'2027-01-25','end':'2027-02-05','owner':'Lena','after':[2]},{'id':4,'name':'Visual_design','start':'2027-02-08','end':'2027-02-19','owner':'Marco','after':[3]},{'name':'Design_sign-off','milestone':true,'date':'2027-02-19','key':true}]},{'name':'Build','items':[{'id':5,'name':'Front-end','start':'2027-02-22','end':'2027-03-26','owner':'Ana_and_Jo','progress':40,'after':[4]},{'id':6,'name':'Content_migration','start':'2027-03-01','end':'2027-03-19','owner':'Sam'},{'name':'Go-live','milestone':true,'date':'2027-04-02','key':true,'after':[5,6]}]}]}&style=deps:true,assignees:true,dateOrder:dmy,progress:true,palette:vivid,font:Lora

## If it doesn't open

Slideline says "That plan link couldn't be read" when the JSON is invalid or the link was cut short. Check that the JSON parses, that every quote is closed, and that the person received the whole link.
